properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued November 9 at 2:38PM CST until November 9 at 6:45PM CST by NWS San Angelo TX
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Kimble County in west central Texas...
Sutton County in west central Texas...

* WHEN...Until 645 PM CST.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 234 PM CST, Another area of moderate to briefly heavy rainfall
is moving into southern Sutton County and will likely spread east
into Kimble County as well. Additional rainfall totals of up to 1
inch or higher are possible. With rain totals of 3-5 inches
across this area over the last 3 days, this additional rain will
quickly run off into creeks, streams, and arroyos. Low water
crossings will likely remain flooded and impassable through the
afternoon and into the evening hours.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Sonora, Junction, Roosevelt, Telegraph, South Llano River State
Park, Segovia, I-10 Near The Sutton-Kimble County Line, The
Intersection Of Ranch Road 2596 And Ranch Road 864, Us-377 Near
The Kimble-Edwards County Line, and Cleo.
- This includes Interstate 10 between Mile Markers 380 and 477.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

NWSheadline: FLOOD ADVISORY IN EFFECT UNTIL 645 PM CST THIS EVENING
